shortDescription: French biotechnology firm Biomérieux EURONEXT:BIM reported on Tuesday a better-than-expected organic sales growth in the third quarter, helped by a 13% increase across key growth areas under its GO28 strategic plan.Total sales for the period came in at €1,042 million ($1.17 billion), up 8% year on…

children: reported on Tuesday a better-than-expected organic sales growth in the third quarter, helped by a 13% increase across key growth areas under its GO28 strategic plan.
Total sales for the period came in at €1,042 million ($1.17 billion), up 8% year on year, above the company's compiled median consensus for sales of €1,007 million and organic growth of 5.9%.
Year-on-year growth at Clinical Applications, which make up 84% of total sales, reached 8% in the quarter, while Industrial Applications, 16% of sales, grew by 9%

BIOFIRE Non-Respiratory panels sales increased by 25% driven by "strong momentum across the entire portfolio", with the cyclosporiasis outbreak in the US boosting demand for BIOFIRE gastrointestinal panel
Biomérieux confirmed its guidance for the full year but added that it now expects a negative currency effect of about €35 million versus the earlier forecast of negative €40-50 million
The company, which targets organic sales growth of 3%-6% per year in 2027 and 2028, aims to expand into women’s health with a new vaginitis panel set to enter the US market in early 2027
